### n=1 labels=QNA var=X gamma=1 sojourn=1 xclass=0 an=0 anlabel= avg=0 decimals=3
awk 'FNR==1{f++}/^=/{next}/^$/{next}function parsci(s){gsub(/[()]/,"",s);return s}f<=1{if($0~/^rho_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;rh[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_rh[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dr)dr=k;next}if($0~/^Gamma_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;gm[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_gm[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dg)dg=k;next}if($0~/^sojourn_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;sj[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_sj[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>ds)ds=k;next}if($0~/^X\(class/){s=$2;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;xc[f,k]=$4;if(NF>=5&&$5~/^\(/)ci_xc[f,k]=parsci($5);if(k>dxc)dxc=k;next}if($0~/^E\[X_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;ex[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_ex[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dx)dx=k;next}}function eqline(n){s="";for(i=0;i<n;i++)s=s"=";return s}function absv(x){return x<0?-x:x}function nz(s){return s ~ /^-0(\.0*)?$/ ? substr(s,2) : s}function fmt7(v,  x){if(v==""||v=="—")return v;x=v+0;if(x!=0&&(absv(x)<1e-3||absv(x)>=1e9))return nz(sprintf("%.2e",x));return nz(sprintf("%.3f",x))}function fmtv(v,ref,ci,  s,vr,rr){if(v=="")return "—";s=fmt7(v);if(ci!="")s=s" ± "fmt7(ci);if(ref==""||ref+0==0)return s;vr=fmt7(v)+0;rr=fmt7(ref)+0;if(rr==0)return s;return sprintf("%s (%+.1f%%)",s,(vr-rr)/rr*100)}function dwid(s,  n,t){t=s;n=length(t);n-=2*gsub(/—/,"",t);n-=gsub(/±/,"",t);return n}function idxw(n){w=1;t=n;while(t>=10){w++;t=int(t/10)}return w}END{wr=idxw(dr);wg=idxw(dg);wsj=idxw(ds);wxc=idxw(dxc);wx=idxw(dx);R=0;NC=2;R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]="QNA";R++;G[R]=1;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]=eqline(3);for(k=1;k<=dr;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("rho_%0*d",wr,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(rh[1,k],"",ci_rh[1,k]);}if(dr>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dg;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("Gamma_%0*d",wg,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(gm[1,k],"",ci_gm[1,k]);}if(dg>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=ds;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("sojourn_%0*d",wsj,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(sj[1,k],"",ci_sj[1,k]);}if(ds>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dx;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("E[X_%0*d]",wx,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(ex[1,k],"",ci_ex[1,k]);}if(dx>0)G[R]=1;for(c=1;c<=NC;c++)mw[c]=0;for(r=1;r<=R;r++)for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){l=dwid(C[r,c]);if(l>mw[c])mw[c]=l}for(r=1;r<=R;r++){for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){printf "%s",C[r,c];if(c<NC){p=mw[c]-dwid(C[r,c])+2;while(p>0){printf " ";p--}}}printf "\n";if(G[r])printf "\n"}}' "F1"
### n=1 labels=QNA var=Q gamma=1 sojourn=1 xclass=0 an=0 anlabel= avg=0 decimals=3
awk 'FNR==1{f++}/^=/{next}/^$/{next}function parsci(s){gsub(/[()]/,"",s);return s}f<=1{if($0~/^rho_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;rh[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_rh[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dr)dr=k;next}if($0~/^Gamma_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;gm[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_gm[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dg)dg=k;next}if($0~/^sojourn_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;sj[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_sj[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>ds)ds=k;next}if($0~/^X\(class/){s=$2;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;xc[f,k]=$4;if(NF>=5&&$5~/^\(/)ci_xc[f,k]=parsci($5);if(k>dxc)dxc=k;next}if($0~/^E\[Q_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;ex[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_ex[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dx)dx=k;next}}function eqline(n){s="";for(i=0;i<n;i++)s=s"=";return s}function absv(x){return x<0?-x:x}function nz(s){return s ~ /^-0(\.0*)?$/ ? substr(s,2) : s}function fmt7(v,  x){if(v==""||v=="—")return v;x=v+0;if(x!=0&&(absv(x)<1e-3||absv(x)>=1e9))return nz(sprintf("%.2e",x));return nz(sprintf("%.3f",x))}function fmtv(v,ref,ci,  s,vr,rr){if(v=="")return "—";s=fmt7(v);if(ci!="")s=s" ± "fmt7(ci);if(ref==""||ref+0==0)return s;vr=fmt7(v)+0;rr=fmt7(ref)+0;if(rr==0)return s;return sprintf("%s (%+.1f%%)",s,(vr-rr)/rr*100)}function dwid(s,  n,t){t=s;n=length(t);n-=2*gsub(/—/,"",t);n-=gsub(/±/,"",t);return n}function idxw(n){w=1;t=n;while(t>=10){w++;t=int(t/10)}return w}END{wr=idxw(dr);wg=idxw(dg);wsj=idxw(ds);wxc=idxw(dxc);wx=idxw(dx);R=0;NC=2;R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]="QNA";R++;G[R]=1;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]=eqline(3);for(k=1;k<=dr;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("rho_%0*d",wr,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(rh[1,k],"",ci_rh[1,k]);}if(dr>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dg;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("Gamma_%0*d",wg,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(gm[1,k],"",ci_gm[1,k]);}if(dg>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=ds;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("sojourn_%0*d",wsj,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(sj[1,k],"",ci_sj[1,k]);}if(ds>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dx;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("E[Q_%0*d]",wx,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(ex[1,k],"",ci_ex[1,k]);}if(dx>0)G[R]=1;for(c=1;c<=NC;c++)mw[c]=0;for(r=1;r<=R;r++)for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){l=dwid(C[r,c]);if(l>mw[c])mw[c]=l}for(r=1;r<=R;r++){for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){printf "%s",C[r,c];if(c<NC){p=mw[c]-dwid(C[r,c])+2;while(p>0){printf " ";p--}}}printf "\n";if(G[r])printf "\n"}}' "F1"
### n=1 labels=QNA var=X gamma=1 sojourn=1 xclass=0 an=1 anlabel=Exact E[N]  (Jackson) avg=0 decimals=3
awk 'FNR==1{f++}/^=/{next}/^$/{next}function parsci(s){gsub(/[()]/,"",s);return s}f<=1{if($0~/^rho_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;rh[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_rh[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dr)dr=k;next}if($0~/^Gamma_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;gm[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_gm[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dg)dg=k;next}if($0~/^sojourn_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;sj[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_sj[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>ds)ds=k;next}if($0~/^X\(class/){s=$2;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;xc[f,k]=$4;if(NF>=5&&$5~/^\(/)ci_xc[f,k]=parsci($5);if(k>dxc)dxc=k;next}if($0~/^E\[X_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;ex[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_ex[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dx)dx=k;next}}f==2&&/^rho_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_rh[k]=$3;if(k>dr)dr=k;next}f==2&&/^Gamma_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_gm[k]=$3;if(k>dg)dg=k;next}f==2&&/^sojourn_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_sj[k]=$3;if(k>ds)ds=k;next}f==2&&/^E\[X_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an[k]=$3;if(k>dx)dx=k;next}function eqline(n){s="";for(i=0;i<n;i++)s=s"=";return s}function absv(x){return x<0?-x:x}function nz(s){return s ~ /^-0(\.0*)?$/ ? substr(s,2) : s}function fmt7(v,  x){if(v==""||v=="—")return v;x=v+0;if(x!=0&&(absv(x)<1e-3||absv(x)>=1e9))return nz(sprintf("%.2e",x));return nz(sprintf("%.3f",x))}function fmtv(v,ref,ci,  s,vr,rr){if(v=="")return "—";s=fmt7(v);if(ci!="")s=s" ± "fmt7(ci);if(ref==""||ref+0==0)return s;vr=fmt7(v)+0;rr=fmt7(ref)+0;if(rr==0)return s;return sprintf("%s (%+.1f%%)",s,(vr-rr)/rr*100)}function dwid(s,  n,t){t=s;n=length(t);n-=2*gsub(/—/,"",t);n-=gsub(/±/,"",t);return n}function idxw(n){w=1;t=n;while(t>=10){w++;t=int(t/10)}return w}END{wr=idxw(dr);wg=idxw(dg);wsj=idxw(ds);wxc=idxw(dxc);wx=idxw(dx);R=0;NC=3;R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]="QNA";C[R,3]="Exact E[N]  (Jackson)";R++;G[R]=1;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]=eqline(3);C[R,3]=eqline(12);for(k=1;k<=dr;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("rho_%0*d",wr,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(rh[1,k],an_rh[k],ci_rh[1,k]);C[R,3]=an_rh[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_rh[k]);}if(dr>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dg;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("Gamma_%0*d",wg,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(gm[1,k],an_gm[k],ci_gm[1,k]);C[R,3]=an_gm[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_gm[k]);}if(dg>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=ds;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("sojourn_%0*d",wsj,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(sj[1,k],an_sj[k],ci_sj[1,k]);C[R,3]=an_sj[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_sj[k]);}if(ds>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dx;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("E[X_%0*d]",wx,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(ex[1,k],an[k],ci_ex[1,k]);C[R,3]=fmt7(an[k]);}if(dx>0)G[R]=1;for(c=1;c<=NC;c++)mw[c]=0;for(r=1;r<=R;r++)for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){l=dwid(C[r,c]);if(l>mw[c])mw[c]=l}for(r=1;r<=R;r++){for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){printf "%s",C[r,c];if(c<NC){p=mw[c]-dwid(C[r,c])+2;while(p>0){printf " ";p--}}}printf "\n";if(G[r])printf "\n"}}' "F1" "AN"

awk 'FNR==1{f++}/^=/{next}/^$/{next}function parsci(s){gsub(/[()]/,"",s);return s}f<=1{if($0~/^rho_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;rh[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_rh[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dr)dr=k;next}if($0~/^Gamma_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;gm[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_gm[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dg)dg=k;next}if($0~/^sojourn_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;sj[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_sj[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>ds)ds=k;next}if($0~/^X\(class/){s=$2;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;xc[f,k]=$4;if(NF>=5&&$5~/^\(/)ci_xc[f,k]=parsci($5);if(k>dxc)dxc=k;next}if($0~/^E\[Q_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;ex[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_ex[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dx)dx=k;next}}f==2&&/^rho_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_rh[k]=$3;if(k>dr)dr=k;next}f==2&&/^Gamma_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_gm[k]=$3;if(k>dg)dg=k;next}f==2&&/^sojourn_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_sj[k]=$3;if(k>ds)ds=k;next}f==2&&/^E\[Q_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an[k]=$3;if(k>dx)dx=k;next}function eqline(n){s="";for(i=0;i<n;i++)s=s"=";return s}function absv(x){return x<0?-x:x}function nz(s){return s ~ /^-0(\.0*)?$/ ? substr(s,2) : s}function fmt7(v,  x){if(v==""||v=="—")return v;x=v+0;if(x!=0&&(absv(x)<1e-3||absv(x)>=1e9))return nz(sprintf("%.2e",x));return nz(sprintf("%.3f",x))}function fmtv(v,ref,ci,  s,vr,rr){if(v=="")return "—";s=fmt7(v);if(ci!="")s=s" ± "fmt7(ci);if(ref==""||ref+0==0)return s;vr=fmt7(v)+0;rr=fmt7(ref)+0;if(rr==0)return s;return sprintf("%s (%+.1f%%)",s,(vr-rr)/rr*100)}function dwid(s,  n,t){t=s;n=length(t);n-=2*gsub(/—/,"",t);n-=gsub(/±/,"",t);return n}function idxw(n){w=1;t=n;while(t>=10){w++;t=int(t/10)}return w}END{wr=idxw(dr);wg=idxw(dg);wsj=idxw(ds);wxc=idxw(dxc);wx=idxw(dx);R=0;NC=3;R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]="QNA";C[R,3]="Exact Result";R++;G[R]=1;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]=eqline(3);C[R,3]=eqline(12);for(k=1;k<=dr;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("rho_%0*d",wr,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(rh[1,k],rh[1,k],ci_rh[1,k]);C[R,3]=an_rh[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_rh[k]);}if(dr>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dg;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("Gamma_%0*d",wg,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(gm[1,k],gm[1,k],ci_gm[1,k]);C[R,3]=an_gm[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_gm[k]);}if(dg>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=ds;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("sojourn_%0*d",wsj,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(sj[1,k],sj[1,k],ci_sj[1,k]);C[R,3]=an_sj[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_sj[k]);}if(ds>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dx;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("E[X_%0*d]",wx,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(ex[1,k],ex[1,k],ci_ex[1,k]);C[R,3]=fmt7(an[k]);}if(dx>0)G[R]=1;for(c=1;c<=NC;c++)mw[c]=0;for(r=1;r<=R;r++)for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){l=dwid(C[r,c]);if(l>mw[c])mw[c]=l}for(r=1;r<=R;r++){for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){printf "%s",C[r,c];if(c<NC){p=mw[c]-dwid(C[r,c])+2;while(p>0){printf " ";p--}}}printf "\n";if(G[r])printf "\n"}}' "F1" "AN"

awk 'FNR==1{f++}/^=/{next}/^$/{next}function parsci(s){gsub(/[()]/,"",s);return s}f<=1{if($0~/^rho_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;rh[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_rh[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dr)dr=k;next}if($0~/^Gamma_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;gm[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_gm[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dg)dg=k;next}if($0~/^sojourn_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;sj[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_sj[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>ds)ds=k;next}if($0~/^X\(class/){s=$2;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;xc[f,k]=$4;if(NF>=5&&$5~/^\(/)ci_xc[f,k]=parsci($5);if(k>dxc)dxc=k;next}if($0~/^E\[Q_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;ex[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_ex[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dx)dx=k;next}}f==2&&/^rho_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_rh[k]=$3;if(k>dr)dr=k;next}f==2&&/^Gamma_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_gm[k]=$3;if(k>dg)dg=k;next}f==2&&/^sojourn_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_sj[k]=$3;if(k>ds)ds=k;next}f==2&&/^E\[Q_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an[k]=$3;if(k>dx)dx=k;next}function eqline(n){s="";for(i=0;i<n;i++)s=s"=";return s}function absv(x){return x<0?-x:x}function nz(s){return s ~ /^-0(\.0*)?$/ ? awk 'FNR==1{f++}/^=/{next}/^$/{next}function parsci(s){gsub(/[()]/,"",s);return s}f<=3{if($0~/^rho_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;rh[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_rh[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dr)dr=k;next}if($0~/^Gamma_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;gm[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_gm[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dg)dg=k;next}if($0~/^sojourn_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;sj[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_sj[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>ds)ds=k;next}if($0~/^X\(class/){s=$2;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;xc[f,k]=$4;if(NF>=5&&$5~/^\(/)ci_xc[f,k]=parsci($5);if(k>dxc)dxc=k;next}if($0~/^E\[Q_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;ex[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_ex[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dx)dx=k;next}}function eqline(n){s="";for(i=0;i<n;i++)s=s"=";return s}function absv(x){return x<0?-x:x}function nz(s){return s ~ /^-0(\.0*)?$/ ? s}f<=3{if($0~/^rho_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;rh[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_rh[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dr)dr=k;next}if($0~/^Gamma_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;gm[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_gm[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dg)dg=k;next}if($0~/^sojourn_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;sj[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_sj[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>ds)ds=k;next}if($0~/^X\(class/){s=$2;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;xc[f,k]=$4;if(NF>=5&&$5~/^\(/)ci_xc[f,k]=parsci($5);if(k>dxc)dxc=k;next}if($0~/^E\[X_/){s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;ex[f,k]=$3;if(NF>=4&&$4~/^\(/)ci_ex[f,k]=parsci($4);if(k>dx)dx=k;next}}f==4&&/^rho_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_rh[k]=$3;if(k>dr)dr=k;next}f==4&&/^Gamma_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_gm[k]=$3;if(k>dg)dg=k;next}f==4&&/^sojourn_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an_sj[k]=$3;if(k>ds)ds=k;next}f==4&&/^E\[X_/{s=$1;gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",s);k=s+0;an[k]=$3;if(k>dx)dx=k;next}function eqline(n){s="";for(i=0;i<n;i++)s=s"=";return s}function absv(x){return x<0?-x:x}function nz(s){return s ~ /^-0(\.0*)?$/ ? substr(s,2) : s}function fmt7(v,  x){if(v==""||v=="—")return v;x=v+0;if(x!=0&&(absv(x)<1e-3||absv(x)>=1e9))return nz(sprintf("%.2e",x));return nz(sprintf("%.3f",x))}function fmtv(v,ref,ci,  s,vr,rr){if(v=="")return "—";s=fmt7(v);if(ci!="")s=s" ± "fmt7(ci);if(ref==""||ref+0==0)return s;vr=fmt7(v)+0;rr=fmt7(ref)+0;if(rr==0)return s;return sprintf("%s (%+.1f%%)",s,(vr-rr)/rr*100)}function dwid(s,  n,t){t=s;n=length(t);n-=2*gsub(/—/,"",t);n-=gsub(/±/,"",t);return n}function idxw(n){w=1;t=n;while(t>=10){w++;t=int(t/10)}return w}END{wr=idxw(dr);wg=idxw(dg);wsj=idxw(ds);wxc=idxw(dxc);wx=idxw(dx);R=0;NC=6;R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]="Spectral";C[R,3]="FE (Gauss)";C[R,4]="Simulation";C[R,5]="Average of Algorithms";C[R,6]="Exact Result";R++;G[R]=1;C[R,1]="";C[R,2]=eqline(8);C[R,3]=eqline(10);C[R,4]=eqline(10);C[R,5]=eqline(21);C[R,6]=eqline(12);for(k=1;k<=dr;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("rho_%0*d",wr,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(rh[1,k],rh[3,k],ci_rh[1,k]);C[R,3]=fmtv(rh[2,k],rh[3,k],ci_rh[2,k]);C[R,4]=fmtv(rh[3,k],rh[3,k],ci_rh[3,k]);_s=0;_c=0;if(rh[1,k]!=""){_s+=rh[1,k]+0;_c++}if(rh[2,k]!=""){_s+=rh[2,k]+0;_c++}if(_c>0)C[R,5]=fmtv(_s/_c,rh[3,k],"");else C[R,5]="—";C[R,6]=an_rh[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_rh[k]);}if(dr>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dg;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("Gamma_%0*d",wg,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(gm[1,k],gm[3,k],ci_gm[1,k]);C[R,3]=fmtv(gm[2,k],gm[3,k],ci_gm[2,k]);C[R,4]=fmtv(gm[3,k],gm[3,k],ci_gm[3,k]);_s=0;_c=0;if(gm[1,k]!=""){_s+=gm[1,k]+0;_c++}if(gm[2,k]!=""){_s+=gm[2,k]+0;_c++}if(_c>0)C[R,5]=fmtv(_s/_c,gm[3,k],"");else C[R,5]="—";C[R,6]=an_gm[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_gm[k]);}if(dg>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=ds;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("sojourn_%0*d",wsj,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(sj[1,k],sj[3,k],ci_sj[1,k]);C[R,3]=fmtv(sj[2,k],sj[3,k],ci_sj[2,k]);C[R,4]=fmtv(sj[3,k],sj[3,k],ci_sj[3,k]);_s=0;_c=0;if(sj[1,k]!=""){_s+=sj[1,k]+0;_c++}if(sj[2,k]!=""){_s+=sj[2,k]+0;_c++}if(_c>0)C[R,5]=fmtv(_s/_c,sj[3,k],"");else C[R,5]="—";C[R,6]=an_sj[k]==""?"—":fmt7(an_sj[k]);}if(ds>0)G[R]=1;for(k=1;k<=dx;k++){R++;G[R]=0;C[R,1]=sprintf("E[X_%0*d]",wx,k);C[R,2]=fmtv(ex[1,k],ex[3,k],ci_ex[1,k]);C[R,3]=fmtv(ex[2,k],ex[3,k],ci_ex[2,k]);C[R,4]=fmtv(ex[3,k],ex[3,k],ci_ex[3,k]);_s=0;_c=0;if(ex[1,k]!=""){_s+=ex[1,k]+0;_c++}if(ex[2,k]!=""){_s+=ex[2,k]+0;_c++}if(_c>0)C[R,5]=fmtv(_s/_c,ex[3,k],"");else C[R,5]="—";C[R,6]=fmt7(an[k]);}if(dx>0)G[R]=1;for(c=1;c<=NC;c++)mw[c]=0;for(r=1;r<=R;r++)for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){l=dwid(C[r,c]);if(l>mw[c])mw[c]=l}for(r=1;r<=R;r++){for(c=1;c<=NC;c++){printf "%s",C[r,c];if(c<NC){p=mw[c]-dwid(C[r,c])+2;while(p>0){printf " ";p--}}}printf "\n";if(G[r])printf "\n"}}' "F1" "F2" "F3" "AN"
